source.provider: IGN / INSEE - Contours IRIS WFS Géoplateforme

auditPolicy.activationRule: A city is ready only when every visible plate has a unique human place name and every merge is exact-ID, same-base and geometrically connected.
auditPolicy.exhaustiveReview: Every official label in all 34 cities was inspected, not only planner lexical risks.
auditPolicy.suffixRule: A numeric suffix family is dissolved only when all members have the exact same human base and the official polygons form a connected graph with at least two shared vertices per graph edge at seven decimals.
auditPolicy.exactAcceptRule: A generic, directional, operational, station or genuine numeric human label is retained only through an exact-ID documented accept when no safer official polygon crosswalk exists.
auditPolicy.technicalRule: Opaque technical inventories require one unique exact-ID human rename per source cell supported by IGN coordinates strictly contained in that exact polygon. Nearest-point assignment is forbidden.
auditPolicy.geometryAdjacency: At least two shared official boundary vertices at seven decimal places; every merged family must form one connected graph.
